context: A boss and his manager read social-issue headlines
purpose: Teach: エイズ/原発/悲惨/脆弱/不能/早急/除去/友好

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の新聞、見たか。アフリカでまたエイズの感染が拡大しているらしい。
lines.en: Did you see this morning's paper? AIDS infections are apparently spreading again in Africa.
lines.style: Gruff boss voice, slow opening, newspaper-in-hand tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。医療体制が脆弱な国では、本当に深刻な問題ですよね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. In countries with fragile medical systems, it's truly a serious problem.
lines.style: Polite subordinate, measured agreement, slight concern in voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 次のページには原発の記事が載っていた。あの事故の被害は本当に悲惨だったな。
lines.en: On the next page there was an article about the nuclear plant. The damage from that accident was truly tragic.
lines.style: Heavier reflective tone, lowered voice, audible sigh between sentences

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 汚染土の除去にも何十年もかかるそうですし、早急な対策が必要だと書いてありました。
lines.en: It said removing the contaminated soil will take decades, and that urgent countermeasures are needed.
lines.style: Reading-aloud cadence, informative delivery, slightly worried undertone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 政府の対応はほとんど機能不能だと、評論家が厳しく批判しているじゃないか。
lines.en: The critics are harshly saying the government's response is essentially dysfunctional, aren't they?
lines.style: Indignant boss, rising volume, pen-tapping irritation throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そういえば社会面に、隣国との友好を訴える特集も組まれていましたよ。
lines.en: Come to think of it, the social section also had a feature urging friendly relations with neighboring countries.
lines.style: Polite topic-shift, brighter pitch, hopeful note rising

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふむ、暗い話ばかりじゃ気が滅入る。たまにはそういう前向きな記事もいいな。
lines.en: Hmm, nothing but dark stories is depressing. Once in a while a positive article like that is nice too.
lines.style: Softening grumble, slow exhale, warmer paternal tone

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、本当に。コーヒー、もう一杯お持ちしましょうか、部長。
lines.en: Yes, truly. Shall I bring you another cup of coffee, sir?
lines.style: Closing politeness, gentle offer, slight smile in voice
